data.name: Adi
data.long_meaning: Adi is a Hebrew name meaning 'Noble, gentle'. It appears in the Bible as a name for various characters, including Adi the son of Jeduthun, who was a musician and temple servant (1 Chronicles 15:17). This name is often given to girls in the Christian tradition due to its biblical and spiritual significance.
